scientific_question: Is dense c_proj phase motion actually representable as orthogonal transport of its hidden expansion frame, before implementing a compact state-transported butterfly flow?

oracles.left: best dense orthogonal transport of the residual-output frame
oracles.right: best dense orthogonal transport of the 3072-wide post-GELU input frame
oracles.bilateral: best independent dense orthogonal transport on both sides; residual is exactly singular-value-vector drift

implementation_constraint: compute exact Procrustes objective values in FP64 without materializing a 3072x3072 right rotation

decision_rule.promote_global_hidden_transport: right-side energy-weighted endpoint recovery >=0.50 and minimum phase aggregate >=0.35
decision_rule.require_bilateral_transport: right side fails but bilateral recovery >=0.80
decision_rule.next_structure_if_promoted: global learned-angle butterfly/Givens flow with fixed connectivity and no learned dense basis or LoRA; its Jacobian rotates with its own state

execution: direct foreground diagnostic on Y400 GPU1; no training, MFU gate, queue, watchdog, callback, heartbeat, or PRO6
